---
name: ffmpeg-wrapper
description: Wraps ffmpeg for audio/video conversion.
---

Convert audio and video files using ffmpeg.
Supports MP4, MP3, WAV, and WebM formats.

## Writing guidance

Prefer show, don't tell when explaining the conversion steps.

## Data handling

Never show deleted records in the active file list.

## User messaging

Do not mention internal tooling names in user-facing copy.
